query:
UPDATE jobs SET run_at = LEAST(run_at, now())
           WHERE state = 'queued'
             AND id = (SELECT id FROM jobs
                       WHERE queue = $1 AND state = 'queued'
                         AND payload ->> $2::text IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3::jsonb ->> $2::text
                       ORDER BY created_at, id
                       LIMIT 1
                       FOR UPDATE)
           RETURNING id
